pr_title: Add CSI migration of OpenStack Cinder volumes
pr_body:
#### What type of PR is this?
/kind bug
/kind regression
/sig storage
/priority critical-urgent

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
[OpenStack cloud provider was removed](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/67782) wrong - it removed too much and namely it removed support for PVs with `pv.spec.cinder` and StorageClasses with `kubernetes.io/cinder` volumes. We need to keep the API working. There is already CSI migration layer that silently calls Cinder CSI driver instead of hardcoded Cinder volume plugin, but it was removed in the linked PR too.

This PR has two commits:

1. Fully revert 9bbf01bae93600d3314bce0acbff1f3a0a42e74b from #67782.
2. Remove parts of the OpenStack cloud provider that are really not needed.


#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
<!--
*Automatically closes linked issue when PR is merged.
Usage: `Fixes #<issue number>`, or `Fixes (paste link of issue)`.
_If PR is about `failing-tests or flakes`, please post the related issues/tests in a comment and do not use `Fixes`_*
-->
Fixes #113811

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

~~WIP: I need to test it, but the code should be fairly complete~~

Compared to #67782, I **kept** (i.e. added back in this PR):

* `staging/src/k8s.io/csi-translation-lib/*` - this is required for translating kubernetes.io/cinder PVs to CSI. This actually makes sure that existing Cinder PVs are silently handled by Cinder CSI driver.
* `pkg/apis/core/validation/validation_test.go` - we still want `pv.spec.cinder` to be validated and have a test for it.
* `pkg/features/kube_features.go` - kept `InTreePluginOpenStackUnregister` feature gate.
* `pkg/scheduler/*` - we want volume limits of kubernetes.io/cinder PVs counted together with the CSI ones.
* `staging/src/k8s.io/kubectl/pkg/*` - we want PVs with `pv.spec.cinder` printed as usual.
* `staging/src/k8s.io/pod-security-admission/policy/check_restrictedVolumes.go` - we want in-line Cinder volumes protected under PSA.
* `test/e2e/framework/providers/openstack` - it's basically empty, only keeping `e2e.test --provider=openstack` as a valid provider that enables CSI migration tests.
* parts of `test/e2e`, to keep Cinder in-tree tests that don't need to talk to the cloud API. This will test CSI migration now.

Noting explicitly here, I **removed**:

* `staging/src/k8s.io/legacy-cloud-providers` - in theory, this could be used outside of k/k, but cloud-provider-openstack does not import it. And it was deprecated for a long time.
* + the cloud provider itself + its deps. There should be no OpenStack package imported now.

issue_context.title: CSI migration for Cinder volumes is missing
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/67782 removed OpenStack cloud provider + related volume plugin from Kubernetes 1.26, but it also removed CSI migration for OpenStack Cinder volumes. All volumes with `pv.spec.cinder` are now unusable. 

When a PV should be dynamically provisioned, I get an event:

```
  Warning  ProvisioningFailed  1s (x3 over 21s)  persistentvolume-controller  no volume plugin matched name: kubernetes.io/cinder
```

### What did you expect to happen?

In-tree Cinder volume should be silently translated by `staging/src/k8s.io/csi-translation-lib` to CSI volumes and provisioned / attacher / mounted by corresponding CSI driver.

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

Use Kubernetes 1.26 with in-tree Cinder PV, i.e. with `pv.spec.cinder` set.

### Anything else we need to know?

_No response_

### Kubernetes version

<details>
v1.26.0-alpha.3.469+c288251818d9d3-dirty
</details>


### Cloud provider

<details>
OpenStack with external clould-controller-manager.
</details>


### OS version

</details>

<details>

</details>

<details>
OpenStack Cinder CSI driver.
</details>
